summary: The open AI model repository and developer inference ecosystem has matured significantly by 2026, with Hugging Face remaining the dominant hub hosting over 2 million models while specialized inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and SiliconFlow compete on cost and speed. The ecosystem is highly concentrated, with the top 200 most downloaded models comprising 49.6% of all downloads, and Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, and Mistral leading cumulative download counts. Developers now have a rich set of alternatives spanning managed inference APIs, serverless GPU compute, local runners, and hybrid hosting platforms.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central open-source hub for sharing, discovering, and running AI models, datasets, and Spaces applications
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and limited inference; Pro plan ~$9/month; Enterprise from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour
features: Largest model repository with 2M+ models and growing
Hugging Face Inference API and Inference Endpoints for serverless and dedicated deployment
Inference Providers tier routing to partners like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and DeepInfra
Spaces for hosting demos and Gradio/Streamlit apps
Datasets and evaluation leaderboards
Fine-tuning support via AutoTrain
Strong community forums and model cards
Top 200 models account for 49.6% of all downloads, with Llama at 476M cumulative downloads by March 2026
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source developers, and organizations wanting a one-stop hub for model discovery, sharing, versioning, and light inference

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that lets developers download and run open-source LLMs on their own hardware with a simple CLI and REST API
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; no API costs; user pays only for own hardware
features: One-command model download and run via CLI
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI client libraries
Supports Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, DeepSeek, and many more
Automatic GPU and Apple Silicon acceleration
Modelfile system for customizing prompts and parameters
Works fully offline with no data leaving the machine
Integrates with LM Studio, Jan, and Open WebUI frontends
platforms.best_for: Developers and privacy-conscious users who want to run open models locally on Mac, Linux, or Windows without cloud costs or data exposure

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Managed cloud platform for running open-source AI models via a simple pay-per-second API without managing infrastructure
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute; no minimum spend; GPU types range from ~$0.0001/sec (CPU) to ~$0.0014/sec (A100); free cold-start tier for public models
features: Largest hosted open-model API catalog with 50K+ models
Supports image, video, audio, and language models
Cog framework for packaging any model into a deployable container
Streaming outputs and webhooks
Fine-tuning support for select models like Flux and Llama
OpenAI-compatible endpoints for language models
Simple Python, Node, and HTTP client libraries
platforms.best_for: Developers and startups wanting the simplest possible API to experiment with or ship products using a wide variety of open-source models without DevOps overhead

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-throughput, low-cost inference API for open-source LLMs with an OpenAI-compatible interface, plus fine-tuning and dedicated endpoints
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; among the lowest LLM inference costs in 2026 (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.10/M tokens); fine-tuning billed per token; dedicated instances available
features: OpenAI-compatible REST API for easy migration
Supports Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, and other leading open models
Custom fine-tuning pipeline with LoRA support
Dedicated GPU endpoints for consistent latency
Serverless autoscaling with no cold-start penalty on popular models
Batch inference for high-volume workloads
Used as a backend Inference Provider within Hugging Face's routing tier
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive developers and companies building LLM-powered applications that need reliable, scalable, OpenAI-compatible open-model inference at low per-token cost

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Ultra-fast inference platform for open-source LLMs and image models, optimized for production latency and throughput
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token and pay-per-image; competitive rates (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B ~$0.10/M tokens); on-demand and reserved capacity options
features: Industry-leading inference speed with custom CUDA kernels and FireAttention
OpenAI-compatible completions and chat API
Supports function calling, JSON mode, and structured outputs
Image generation models including Flux variants
Fine-tuned model deployment on shared or dedicated infrastructure
Compound AI system support for multi-model pipelines
Also available as an Inference Provider through Hugging Face
platforms.best_for: Production teams building latency-sensitive applications such as real-time chat, coding assistants, or agent systems that require fast open-model inference at scale

platforms.name: SiliconFlow
platforms.purpose: All-in-one AI model hosting and high-performance inference platform positioned as a best-value option for both hosting and serving open models
platforms.pricing: Competitive pay-per-token pricing; noted as best-value option in 2026 comparisons; free tier available for popular models
features: Ranked #1 for value among AI model hosting platforms in 2026
Faster inference speeds than many competitors on equivalent hardware
All-in-one platform covering hosting, inference, and management
Supports leading open models including Qwen, DeepSeek, and Llama families
OpenAI-compatible API
Strong performance-to-cost ratio for high-volume deployments
Particularly popular for serving Chinese-origin open models like Qwen
platforms.best_for: Organizations and developers seeking the best cost-performance ratio for hosting and serving open models, particularly those working with Qwen or DeepSeek model families

platforms.name: DeepInfra
platforms.purpose: Serverless inference API for open-source LLMs, embedding models, and image models at competitive commodity pricing
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token; among the lowest-cost providers (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.06/M tokens); no subscription required
features: OpenAI-compatible API with drop-in replacement support
Covers text generation, embeddings, transcription, and image generation
Supports DeepSeek, Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and Whisper families
No cold starts on popular models
Straightforward dashboard with usage analytics
Listed as a recommended direct alternative to Hugging Face Inference Providers
platforms.best_for: Developers and researchers who want bare-minimum-cost access to a broad set of open models via a simple API without platform lock-in or minimum commitments

platforms.name: OpenRouter
platforms.purpose: Unified API gateway that aggregates access to dozens of LLM providers and models under a single endpoint with automatic fallback and routing
platforms.pricing: Pass-through pricing from underlying providers plus a small routing margin; no subscription; pay only for tokens consumed
features: Single OpenAI-compatible API key for models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Meta, Google, DeepSeek, and more
Automatic provider fallback for high availability
Model routing based on cost, latency, or context length
Supports both open and proprietary models in one interface
Real-time pricing and latency leaderboard
Useful for A/B testing models in production
Listed as a top Hugging Face inference alternative for routing use cases
platforms.best_for: Developers who want a single integration point to access and compare both open and closed models across multiple providers, or who need automatic failover between inference backends

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.purpose: Python-first serverless GPU compute platform for running, deploying, and scaling AI model inference and training workloads with full code control
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of GPU compute; free tier includes $30/month credits; A10G ~$0.00137/sec; H100 ~$0.00463/sec
features: Deploy any Python function or model as a serverless endpoint with a decorator
Full control over environment, dependencies, and model weights
Fast cold starts with image caching and volume mounts
Supports vLLM, TGI, and custom inference stacks
Scheduled jobs, batch processing, and streaming responses
GPU types from T4 to H100 available on demand
No Kubernetes or Docker expertise required
platforms.best_for: ML engineers and developers who need full infrastructure control and want to deploy custom or fine-tuned models serverlessly without managing clusters

platforms.name: Baseten
platforms.purpose: Production inference platform for deploying custom and fine-tuned open-source models with performance optimization and enterprise SLAs
platforms.model_count: Bring-your-own plus curated templates for popular models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-compute-hour; dedicated and autoscaling GPU instances; pricing on request for enterprise; roughly $2–5/hr per GPU depending on type
features: Truss framework for packaging and deploying any model reproducibly
Pre-built templates for Llama, Mistral, Whisper, Stable Diffusion, and more
Autoscaling from zero with configurable scale-to-zero
High-throughput serving with continuous batching via TensorRT-LLM and vLLM
Private deployments with VPC peering options
Observability dashboard with latency and throughput metrics
Listed as a top production inference host alternative to Hugging Face
platforms.best_for: Engineering teams that need to deploy fine-tuned or custom models in production with performance guarantees, private networking, and enterprise support

platforms.name: RunPod
platforms.purpose: Raw GPU cloud rental platform for training, fine-tuning, and self-hosted model serving at low hourly rates
platforms.pricing: Spot and on-demand GPU rental; community cloud from ~$0.20/hr (RTX 3090) to ~$2.49/hr (H100); secure cloud at premium; storage billed separately
features: Wide GPU selection from consumer RTX cards to H100 clusters
Persistent storage volumes for model weights and datasets
One-click templates for Ollama, ComfyUI, vLLM, Kohya, and more
Serverless endpoint option for autoscaled inference
SSH and Jupyter access to pods
Network volumes shareable across pods
Global datacenter regions for low latency
platforms.best_for: Researchers, hobbyists, and cost-focused teams who want affordable raw GPU access for training runs, fine-tuning jobs, or self-managed model serving without abstraction layers
